text: What made him die? I don't know. All I know is he swelled up past in his sex and died. Well, what was the cause of his death? Your cause whatever. The dog had a good home, plenty to eat and drink, and a good place to sleep. And all the rest of the dog's human neighborhood seemed to think pretty well of him. Oh, you stupid fella. How did he come to meet his death? He didn't come to meet his death at all. Death overtook him. No, no, no. How did he come to die?
